newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chesapeake Energy cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chesapeake Energy cut.

text.p: UBS Securities said analyst Christopher Eades downgraded Chesapeake Energy Corp to hold from strong buy.
-- on Friday Chesapeake said it expects to take a pretax writedown of about $150-$200 million in the quarter ending June 30 as a result of disappointing drilling results in Louisiana.
-- the analyst cut his earnings estimate for Chesapeake's fiscal 1997 year ending June 30 to $0.70 from $0.75 and cut fiscal 1998 to $0.40 from $0.85.
-- his fiscal 1999 view dropped to $0.30 from $1.05.
